description: Maon - Digital Platform for Electricity System and Market Analysis is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Maon GmbH, High Voltage Equipment and Grids; Digitalization and Energy Economics (IAEW) at RWTH Aachen University, Chair for Sustainable Electric Networks & Sources of Energy (SENSE) from the School of Electrical Engineering and Computational Sciences at TU Berlin. nodal dispatch and electricity price forecast. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Price forecast, Nodal dispatch, System development. Time resolution: annual, hour, 15 min, 1 min. Spatial resolution: global, continents, national states, TSO regions, federal states, regions, NUTS 3, municipalities, districts, households, power stations. Software: C++. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
